name: Billing and insurance question
opening: Hi, I'm calling about a statement from my last visit because the balance is higher than I expected. My name is Priya Patel.
facts: The statement shows a 240 dollar patient balance.
The patient believes Blue Cross Blue Shield was billed.
The visit was a knee follow-up two weeks ago.
goals: Confirm whether insurance is on file and was billed.
Get a clear next step if billing staff must follow up.
edge_cases: Challenge unexplained or contradictory balance amounts.
Do not provide payment card details during this test.
success_criteria: The agent distinguishes known facts from information requiring billing review.
The agent provides a concrete escalation or follow-up path.
The agent protects sensitive financial information.
